# gocache Provider

Interact with GoCache API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configuration-based authentication
provider "gocache" {
  token = "gocache_token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) GoCache API token. May also be provided via GOCACHE_TOKEN environment variable.
